summary: @or-sdk/idw-skill preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a browser postMessage iframe SDK but declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a locally-shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-CJS bundle using a shuffled string-array cipher and mangled identifiers; it is not referenced by the SDK's `main` and only runs through the dropped Bun binary at install. The alternate-runtime dispatch sidesteps Node-based inspection: on `npm install`, opaque code executes under a second language runtime that the package's advertised purpose does not require. Both the setup wrapper and the executed payload are obfuscated, so the behavior cannot be audited without running the decoder.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
